name: Nobody Closed the Sarcophagi
source:
For Count Ottavio dei Catii's eighth birthday party (he's actually fifty), three great singers from history have been summoned back from the dead for a grand musical performance. Unfortunately, the necromancer tasked with reviving the corpses used a corrupted stone for one of them, and then... promptly collapsed! Now one of the singers — nobody knows which one of the three — walks around the party, free, completely unaware that their singing may be lethal to every soul in the room!

Play as our protagonist, only somewhat knowledgeable about necromancy, as they try to navigate the party and get close to the revenants, grappling with self-doubt and their own past as they talk about art, connection, and fate, in order to sneak a glimpse of the singers' reanimation stones, find the corrupted one and extract it before it's too late... and all of this while trying not to completely ruin the show!

[From [url=https://dontsaycat.itch.io/nobody-closed-the-sarcophagi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在奥塔维奥·德·卡蒂伯爵 (Count Ottavio dei Catii) 的八岁生日派对上（他实际上已经五十岁了），历史上三位伟大的歌手被复活，进行了一场盛大的音乐表演。不幸的是，负责复活尸体的死灵法师对其中一具尸体使用了一块腐化的石头，然后……立刻倒下了！现在，其中一位歌手——没有人知道三人中的哪一位——在派对上自由地走来走去，完全没有意识到他们的歌声可能对房间里的每个灵魂都是致命的！

扮演我们的主角，对死灵术只有一点了解，他们试图在队伍中航行并接近亡魂，在谈论艺术、联系和命运时与自我怀疑和自己的过去作斗争，以便偷看歌手的复活石，找到腐化的复活石并在为时已晚之前将其提取出来……所有这一切都在努力不完全毁掉节目！

[来自[url=https://dontsaycat.itch.io/nobody-closed-the-sarcophagi]itch.io[/url]]
